review: 701.66a-1: the does_not_fire variant fizzled the spell with Boomerang, an outcome rule 608.2b decides, not 701.66a; replaced it with A choosing B's Island as the target, which 701.66a's 'target land you control' rejects (Forge: Land.YouCtrl), and dropped Boomerang from the setup and cards.
triage: rules/triage/701.66.jsonl was missing, so validate never checked this file; wrote it.

scenarios.title: Earthbend turns a land you control into a hasty creature with counters
decisions: A casts Earthbending Lesson targeting the fifth Forest, tapping the other four Forests.
Both players pass; Earthbending Lesson resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The targeted Forest is a 4/4 land creature with haste: it has four +1/+1 counters, is still a land that taps for {G}, and can attack this turn.

variants.label: opponents_land
variants.delta: A chooses one of B's Islands as the target instead of the fifth Forest.
variants.expected: B's Island is not a legal target, because earthbend targets only a land A controls. Earthbending Lesson cannot be cast with that target; no land becomes a creature and no counters are placed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's EarthbendEffect applies the 0/0 base power and toughness, the Creature type and Haste with a fresh timestamp, then adds the counters.

scenarios.title: An earthbent land returns tapped when it dies or is exiled

setup.notes: B holds all three instants and has one land for each, but casts only one.

decisions: A casts Earthbending Lesson targeting the fifth Forest, tapping the other four Forests.
Both players pass; Earthbending Lesson resolves and the Forest is a 4/4 land creature with haste.
A passes priority. B casts Terror targeting the earthbent Forest, tapping both Swamps.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The earthbent Forest dies and moves to A's graveyard. Its delayed trigger fires and returns it to the battlefield tapped under A's control as a plain Forest: no counters, not a creature.

variants.label: exiled
variants.delta: B casts Swords to Plowshares (tapping Plains) instead of Terror.
variants.expected: The earthbent Forest is exiled and A gains 4 life (24). Its delayed trigger fires and returns it to the battlefield tapped under A's control as a plain Forest: no counters, not a creature.

variants.label: bounced
variants.delta: B casts Unsummon (tapping Island) instead of Terror.
variants.expected: The earthbent Forest returns to A's hand. It did not die and was not exiled, so no delayed trigger fires and nothing returns to the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: The delayed triggers are registered by EarthbendEffect for the Graveyard and Exile destinations only.

scenarios.title: Earthbending triggers abilities only when the delayed trigger is created

setup.notes: Libraries are listed top first. Avatar Aang has 'Whenever you waterbend, earthbend, firebend, or airbend, draw a card' and is not summoning sick.

decisions: A casts Earthbending Lesson targeting the fifth Forest, tapping the other four Forests.
B passes priority; Earthbending Lesson resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The targeted Forest becomes a 4/4 land creature with haste. Avatar Aang's trigger fires and A draws Plains.

variants.label: target_removed
variants.delta: In response, B casts Boomerang targeting the targeted Forest, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: The Forest returns to A's hand and Earthbending Lesson fizzles. No earthbending happens, Avatar Aang's trigger does not fire and A draws no card.
